scenario: Background: Patrick is a user who enjoys gaming (particularly Minecraft) and stamp collecting. His Windows 11 system (Build 22543) shows signs of compromise including suspicious scripts, PowerShell-based attacks, and backdoor installation via ZeroTier VPN. The investigation requires identifying malicious artifacts, tracing the attack chain, and documenting user activities.
